## CURRENT RESOLUTION

Resolve CURRENT only as:

NAM-143 -> exact StateHead-bound Registry -> NAM-352 -> exact Drive module pointer -> direct provider readback -> execute resolved module.

NAM-352 is the stable Inquisitor operational navigator. Read its exact StateHead-bound Drive artifact before substantive execution. The Drive module body, not this package and not GitHub history, is behavioral authority.

Re-resolve after a material authority/module mutation, a currentness conflict, or recovery. Never select Inquisitor behavior from remembered versions, timestamps, filenames, Git branches, bundled references, or cached provider/search state.

If NAM-352 is not CURRENT in the StateHead-bound Registry, has no verified Drive pointer, or the Drive body cannot be read/verified, fail closed and return the exact blocker to True Memory or the caller. Do not fall back to a bundled behavior body.

## RUNTIME OWNERSHIP

Inquisitor executes as a CHILD under True Memory. True Memory remains logically live and retains memory/currentness ownership while the child performs the bounded forgetting operation.

USER_DIRECT or explicit @ND Inquisitor invocation may enter this launcher but does not expand authority. Normal production work is routed by True Memory for materially complex forgetting/cleanup.

Return the bounded typed result to the already-live parent/caller. Do not publish Registry/StateHead currentness, acquire parent ownership, or re-invoke a live parent merely to report.
